detected_fault: BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) with error codes KMODE EXCEPTION NOT HANDLED and CRITICAL PROCESS DIED
suggested_solution: Check for BIOS updates in Lenovo Vantage software.
Ensure that all drivers are up-to-date, especially graphics, memory, and other relevant drivers.
Verify that XMP profiles are enabled via the BIOS settings (if applicable).
Run a thorough system scan to identify any other potential issues.
